title: CineMem: Attention-Aligned Fine-grained Memory Retrieval for Multi-Shot Long Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.17926v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Autoregressive video generation relies on memory retrieval to model long-range dependencies. This capability becomes particularly critical for multi-shot generation, where models must reconcile substantial visual changes across shot transitions with persistent semantic continuity. Existing methods tend to perform memory retrieval at the frame level and share the same historical context across all query tokens, overlooking the heterogeneous information needs and leading to redundant retrieval and inefficient use of historical memory. To bridge this gap, we introduce CineMem, an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online memory organization with query-adaptive retrieval for autoregressive multi-shot video generation. translated_title: CineMem：面向多镜头长视频生成的注意力对齐细粒度记忆检索
translated_abstract: 自回归视频生成依赖记忆检索来建模长程依赖关系。这一能力对于多镜头生成尤为关键，因为模型必须在镜头切换带来的剧烈视觉变化与持续的语义连贯性之间取得平衡。现有方法往往在帧级别执行记忆检索，并让所有查询令牌共享相同的历史上下文，忽视了异质的信息需求，从而导致冗余检索和历史记忆的低效利用。为弥合这一差距，我们提出了 CineMem，一个面向自回归多镜头视频生成的注意力对齐细粒度记忆检索框架，它将在线记忆组织与查询自适应检索相结合。具体而言，在通过注意力分析所揭示的内在记忆访问模式的引导下，我们提出了一种在线聚类的 KV 缓存作为对所有历史……（摘要在此处截断）的记忆组织策略。
tldr: 提出 CineMem 框架，通过基于注意力分析引导的在线聚类 KV 缓存与查询自适应检索机制，为自回归多镜头长视频生成实现细粒度记忆检索，克服了传统帧级共享检索带来的冗余和低效问题。
en_tdlr: CineMem is an attention-aligned fine-grained memory retrieval framework that combines online-clustered KV cache organization with query-adaptive retrieval to enable efficient and semantically coherent multi-shot long video generation.
